model: Hamilton Khaki Navy Scuba Auto H82395331
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the straight front photo (40 mm outer bezel, listing; lug gap 19.84 mm measured against 20 mm listed). Heights before the house depth scale (12.95 mm thick listing). House method: modelled brushed case, lugs and crown guards, polished coin-edge bezel and crown, applied polished indices with lume, modelled hands; photo maps only for the dial with the bezel insert, and for the rubber strap.

case.note: brushed middle case ring: its flank is the outer silhouette at 9 o'clock (the anchor), just outside the bezel teeth; crown guards from the photo silhouette at 3 o'clock, top falling from 7.8 mm at r 20 to 3.6 mm at r 23

lug.note: outline from the trace (mean of the four lugs, offset out from the inner edge per depth below the tip); brushed top sloping to the tip, polished edges

bezel.note: 90 rounded teeth (bevelled lobes, a little below the polished flat) over a dark skirt so the notches read as shadow; polished flat to the black insert; insert photo-mapped, rising a little outward

dial.note: flat dial with the orange minute track (print), short wall up to the crystal ring

indices.note: applied: polished frame (lume outline grown by 5 px) with lume, trapezoids at 12, 3, 6, 9 and bars

hands.note: sword hour and minute hands: polished frame, lume, black tails with polished edges; black seconds hand with an orange arrow and lume, rectangular tail

crown.note: screw-down crown, 6.5 mm across, flutes along the axis, rounded end

strap.note: orange rubber, 19.4 mm (photo), house curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end = tip + 2.2 x radius; starts under the case; each side samples the photo's straight strap with the lug tips aligned

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: bezel, crown, index frames, hands, bevels

steel_brushed.note: house brushed steel: case, lugs, crown guards

lume.note: white lume with a cool tint (photo)

review.subtitle: Brushed steel case, black and orange dial, black diver's bezel, orange rubber strap. Front relief GLB.
notes: House method: case, lugs, crown guards, coin-edge bezel and crown are modelled in the house steel; the applied indices and the hands are modelled too. The photo is used only for the dial print, the bezel insert and the rubber strap.
The photo is turned about 1 degree; the model is straight and the print is mapped through that turn.
The strap curls under at both ends, like the other tracker watches. The buckle is left out.
